title: Garden Cottage in 12 South
description:
Get the best of both worlds: enjoy an easy walk to one of Nashville's most popular streets while returning to a getaway on a quiet street. Wake up to a view of tree branches outside a wall of windows in this hotel-like studio apartment perfect for two. 

Walk to: 
- 8th & Roast Coffee (5 min) 
- Ladybird Taco, E+Rose (10 min) 
- all of the dining, drinks, and shopping you can imagine on 12th South! (12 min) 

Easy drive: 
- Vanderbilt, Belmont
- Downtown 
- the Gulch 
- Radnor Lake

The space
The cottage offers a cozy feel with a queen bed, full bath, and kitchenette. It is located on the rear of our property and faces our screened-in porch. The mounted TV can be swiveled to enjoy a show while in bed or relaxing on the couch.

Guest access
You’ll access the cottage by entering the gate along the alley. Parking is always available on our quiet street.

Other things to note
As pictured, our dog Rainey is our third co-host. She is low key and sweet! She will not enter the cottage but you may see her in the yard.

If you are allergic or prefer not to interact with Rainey, let us know and we will keep her inside during your stay.
